question: What is the main goal of a professional nursing organization?

options.A: Clinical excellence and standards of practice
options.B: Supplying pharmaceutical drugs to local clinics
options.D: Negotiating daily shift allowances for workers

explanation: You got this! Professional groups focus on setting high standards for patient care and ethics, rather than daily wage talks. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h1)

question: How do professional nursing bodies differ from trade unions?

options.A: Unions focus mainly on wages and work conditions
options.B: Professional bodies have no interest in patient care
options.C: Unions only admit doctors and senior hospital staff
options.D: Professional bodies legally own all Nigerian hospitals

explanation: Spot on! While unions fight for salaries and better working conditions, professional bodies look after practice standards and ethics. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h1)

question: Which of these is a great benefit you get from a nursing professional body?

options.A: Exemption from annual nursing license fees
options.C: Free housing within the hospital premises
options.D: Guaranteed promotion to senior ward manager

explanation: Exactly! They provide journals and resources to keep you updated with the latest evidence-based nursing care. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h2)

question: Why is networking through nursing bodies so helpful for your career?

options.A: It removes the need to write board exams
options.B: It connects nurses with mentors and specialists
options.C: It automatically grants a doctor medical license
options.D: It guarantees exemption from night shift duties

explanation: Well done! Networking opens doors to wonderful mentors who guide you and help you grow in your nursing journey. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h2)

question: What is the main job of the Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria (NMCN)?

options.A: Managing international travel grants for researchers
options.B: Providing loans to build private nursing homes
options.C: Regulating licensure and nursing education standards
options.D: Striking for hazard allowances in federal hospitals

explanation: Spot on! The NMCN is our guardian body that sets school standards, conducts exams, and issues our licenses to practice. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h3)

question: Which organization serves as the main professional umbrella for Nigerian nurses and midwives?

options.B: National Association of Nigerian Nurses and Midwives

explanation: You nailed it! NANNM stands tall as the umbrella body protecting the unity and welfare of nurses and midwives in Nigeria. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h3)

question: In global healthcare, what does ICN stand for?
explanation: Correct! ICN brings together national nurses' associations from all over the world. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h4)

question: Why should local nursing associations connect with global bodies like the ICN?

options.A: To eliminate the need for clinical practice guidelines
options.B: To bypass local nursing board examinations
options.C: To share research and align with global standards
options.D: To take over the duties of the national health ministry

explanation: That's right! Connecting globally helps us learn best practices from around the world and improve patient care locally. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h4)

question: A nurse notices that short staffing is putting patients at risk on the ward. What is the best professional step to take?

options.A: Posting patient details on social media to raise awareness
options.B: Ignoring the staffing shortage to avoid conflict with management
options.C: Resigning immediately without informing the nursing supervisor
options.D: Reporting the safety issue through organized association channels

explanation: Great thinking! Always use proper organizational channels to fix safety issues while keeping patient info strictly confidential. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h5)

question: How do professional nursing bodies help influence healthcare laws?

options.A: By stopping all medical research in public hospitals
options.B: By directly passing laws in the national parliament
options.C: By replacing the judicial court system for nurses
options.D: By lobbying government and health policymakers

explanation: Spot on! They use expert advice and advocacy to help government leaders make health policies that make sense for nurses and patients. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h5)

question: What is a major reason why professional bodies require continuing education units (CEUs)?

options.A: To determine standard monthly salary increments in clinics
options.B: To qualify nurses for hospital administrative promotions only
options.C: To replace formal university nursing degree programs
options.D: To fulfill requirements for annual nursing license renewal

explanation: You got it! Gathering CEUs through ongoing learning helps you renew your practice license and stay sharp. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h6)

question: Why is lifelong learning so important for nurses in clinical practice?

options.A: To keep pace with evolving medical science and technology
options.B: To eliminate the need for hospital orientation programs
options.C: To allow nurses to prescribe medications without doctors
options.D: To ensure nurses never have to work night shifts again

explanation: Brilliant! Medicine and nursing change fast, so keeping up-to-date ensures you give the safest, best care to your patients. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h6)
